Replied in the thread on your message.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel says nothing else about the guard until 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checking in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Both lanes were confirmed working at 11:07 AM.

I can only see #inc-vtg-hartford, so anything the guard did outside it isn't covered.
